ctbids-49744-5814122.description:
This curated 6-piece estate collection brings together timeless American silver dining service elements, showcasing classic profiles and beautiful antique appeal. The collection features solid sterling silver salt and pepper sets alongside a weighted candlestick and a beautiful antique Gorham silver-plated finger bowl. This group makes an exceptional addition to a vintage holiday landscape, a classic tabletop vignette, or a growing silver collection.
•          Included Pieces & Specifications:
o  Sterling Components (Total Combined Weight: 309 Grams)
§ One (1) Vintage Weighted Sterling Candlestick: Features a beautiful flared base with classic stepped detailing. Stamped "Sterling Weighted" on the base rim. Individual weight is 255 grams.
§ Two (2) Baluster-Style Salt & Pepper Shakers: Traditional footed shakers with delicate pierced finial tops. Stamped "Sterling Weighted" on the underside.
§ Two (2) Mini Cylindrical Shakers: Highly collectible solid sterling individual condiment shakers featuring traditional perforated caps. Stamped "Sterling" along with pattern number "745" on the underside.
o  Silver-Plated Components (Weight: 70 Grams)
§ One (1) Antique Gorham Manufacturing Co. Finger Bowl: A beautiful, heavy-gauge round finger bowl featuring a slightly flared lip and a three-line concentric etched band accent near the neck. The base is clearly marked with Gorham’s traditional four-shield silver-plate pseudo-hallmarks (including the distinct flying eagle symbol) and pattern number "535". Individual weight is exactly 70 grams.
•          All pieces are in good authentic vintage/antique condition with a lovely natural patina, light age-appropriate surface wear, and areas of tarnish. No major deep cracks or structural failures. The weighted components sit flat and stable. The items are being sold exactly as found, leaving any professional polishing or cleaning to the preference of the buyer.

283823353.description:
Collection of 14 rough mineral specimens primarily composed of feldspar with visible inclusions of black tourmaline (schorl) and quartz. The stones range in color from off-white to beige, some exhibiting orange-brown staining. They have a coarse, crystalline texture with jagged edges and raw, unpolished surfaces. Black tourmaline appears as thin veins or small patches within the feldspar matrix, alongside quartz inclusions. Specimens vary in size and shape, preserved in natural condition. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or lapidary projects.

Dimensions: For size reference, the largest size is 2.5 x 1.5 inches

283904881.description:
Geode, Crystal & Mineral Specimen Collection Lot
Natural & Polished Geological Specimens
Multi-Piece Assortment, 9.4 lbs Total Weight
A diverse collection of lapidary and geological specimens featuring natural geodes, polished bookend halves, druzy quartz plates, and mineral formations. The assortment highlights varied crystallization habits, quartz interiors, banded chalcedony agate rings, and crystalline clusters suitable for study, display, or lapidary crafting.
Includes 2 cut and polished display geode halves (one dyed blue agate, one natural grey banded agate)
Multiple hollow quartz geodes with sparkling internal crystal druse
Several druzy crystalline quartz plates and mineral clusters
Metallic mineral cluster and bagged assortment of small crystal fragments and stones
Combined specimen weight: approximately 9.4 lbs
Condition:
Natural geological specimens with rough matrix exteriors and naturally fractured surfaces. Polished faces on the two cut agate bookends are smooth with flat bases for freestanding tabletop display. Minor natural shedding of small crystal debris is typical of raw mineral geodes.

Ideal for geological study, home decor, or as a foundational set for mineral collectors.

Assortment of approximately 15 polished tumbled stones in various sizes and colors
